title: Lims on Lims on Lims

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Okay, yup. Yup. Uh-huh. I gotta - yeah - look... alright, gotta go bye. Whoooo. Sorry about that. Wait - who are you? Do you play?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, yup. Yup. Uh-huh. I gotta - yeah - look... alright, gotta go bye. Whoooo. Sorry about that. Wait - who are you? Do you play?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Anything. I can get you on the boards for whatever, long as you win. Could make you Lims right here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything. I can get you on the boards for whatever, long as you win. Could make you Lims right here.
Oh, that wasn't the Comms.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: So? Do you play or not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So? Do you play or not?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Eh, a DeepNet river flowing to a business acquaintance. Have quite a few of 'em running. I'll suffer a short before I let the 'Sec's bullshit keep me from Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, a DeepNet river flowing to a business acquaintance. Have quite a few of 'em running. I'll suffer a short before I let the 'Sec's bullshit keep me from Lims.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Neon Gods. Yeah, it is. Now why are you here? Are you looking to play or what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neon Gods. Yeah, it is. Now why are you here? Are you looking to play or what?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: You know why I hang out here? Why Metro Hub is the place to be, specifically this spot?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know why I hang out here? Why Metro Hub is the place to be, specifically this spot?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Look over there. Those red and green lights? Every train in Nivalis is on that board at some point, and every one of them has a time of arrival and a time of departure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look over there. Those red and green lights? Every train in Nivalis is on that board at some point, and every one of them has a time of arrival and a time of departure.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Sometimes I make a stack a minute.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes I make a stack a minute.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: When Sec comps me for all the business lost due to the Comms bullshit, not to mention locking us in this part of Nivalis like we're in isolation or something? Yeah, maybe then I'll think about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When Sec comps me for all the business lost due to the Comms bullshit, not to mention locking us in this part of Nivalis like we're in isolation or something? Yeah, maybe then I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Love the lure of easy Lims, huh? Alright, come back tomorrow and I'll show you how it runs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Love the lure of easy Lims, huh? Alright, come back tomorrow and I'll show you how it runs.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Hey, hold on a sec - Artemis... Artemis! Don't hang up. I guarantee I can get the seats filled before the flag drops, yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, hold on a sec - Artemis... Artemis! Don't hang up. I guarantee I can get the seats filled before the flag drops, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Once you learn the routes it's pretty easy to gamble on delays.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once you learn the routes it's pretty easy to gamble on delays.
Play what?
How?
I don't gamble.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How were you on the Comms just now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How were you on the Comms just now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How were you on the Comms just now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How were you on the Comms just now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What was it?
Ok...
Isn't that illegal?
That's wicked.
No.
Food's good?
Really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should donate some to get the trains fixed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should donate some to get the trains fixed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You should donate some to get the trains fixed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You should donate some to get the trains fixed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously? Show me how.
How do you win?
And?

Demeanor is an NPC expression, not a relationship-meter change.
Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
